BLAZING TOURIST BUS STALLS EDSA TRAFFIC

A tourist bus traveling to Cavite caught fire on Friday, leading to delayed train operations and heavy traffic along EDSA, the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority said.

According to the MMDA, the fire broke out at 6:10 p.m. and disrupted operations of the Metro Rail Transit Line 3. Train operations resumed at 6:50 p.m. after MRT-3 personnel confirmed that the overhead catenary system showed no burn marks.

Read: https://t.co/YJhS93ip4S

The agency said it will be reopened to light vehicles on Monday. | via @andietagz https://t.co/aPILKf2bXV

SARADO PA RIN

The Department of Public Works and Highways said the EDSA-Ortigas Interchange will remain closed on Sunday, April 26, following the tourist bus fire incident, as clearing, repairs, and load testing continue.

The interchange is set to reopen on Monday, April 27, but only to light vehicles, while the Metropolitan Manila Development Authority implements traffic measures in the area.

📸 DPWH
